purpose: Classify armor-production numbers before they are used in dated Branch events.

tiers.A: dated wartime Japanese production/completion/order document or clearly identified arsenal/HQ table with accounting basis
tiers.B: postwar official arsenal/Ordnance Administrative/USSBS table with accounting basis understood
tiers.C: modern official institutional history or high-quality synthesis for development chronology
tiers.D: secondary production summary useful as a cross-check, not sufficient alone for dated allocation

sources.name: Sagami Army Arsenal / Army Ordnance monthly production tables
sources.basis: Japanese fiscal year Apr-Mar; categories may include repair/acceptance and are not automatically national new-build totals
sources.use: primary accounting gate; model-by-model transcription needed

sources.name: 1944-02-04 Complete Vehicles Production Status Table
sources.use: strong check against postwar bookkeeping; currently particularly useful for Ke-Ni

sources.name: JGSDF 7th Division tank-history chronology
sources.use: Chi-He completion Jun1943, production spring1944; Chi-Nu decision May1944/prototype Sep/production Oct; Chi-To line from 1942H2

sources.name: Zaloga/Osprey annual family production table
sources.basis: widely repeated annual family totals; calendar-vs-fiscal/new-build-vs-acceptance basis not safe enough for dated simulation without cross-check

sources.name: Karyu primary-document reconstructions
sources.basis: modern analysis reproducing named wartime/postwar Japanese documents
sources.use: valuable for identifying accounting errors and exact source tables; original document remains preferred when readable

KeNi.revised: FY1942 24; FY1943 about 15 actual completions; postwar 89 figure appears to include a 74-unit tractor bookkeeping error
KeNi.branch_effect: No Ke-Ni mass-production wallet exists to raid for hundreds of extra mediums.

ChiHe.revised: 15 can be an FY1943 tail in Feb-Mar 1944; JGSDF places mass production in spring 1944
ChiHe.confidence: HIGH on no routine calendar-1943 mass issue; exact pilot/pre-series count OPEN

Shinhoto.common_claim: 503 in 1942 + 427 in 1943, plus ~300 old hull conversions
Shinhoto.revised: use as family-total scaffold; dated monthly distribution and accounting basis remain OPEN

mandatory_rule: Every number entering a dated OOB must carry source tier, accounting basis, physical-new/retrofit/repair classification, acceptance date, and unit/shipping gate.
